    Endpoint subbimodules form chains #

    Lemma 3.1(3) (lem:endpoint-chains, projective-rays.tex). For a representation-finite algebra A over an algebraically closed field with primitive idempotents e_x, put R_x = e_xAe_x.

    • Each R_x is local with residue field k: R_x = k e_x + rad R_x, with rad R_x = R_x ∩ rad A nilpotent.
    • An R_x--R_y-subbimodule N of A(x, y) is recovered from the ideal it generates, e_x(ANA)e_y = N; so there are finitely many.
    • Two incomparable subbimodules would give k² in the socle of (N₁ + N₂)/(N₁ ∩ N₂), whose infinitely many lines lift to distinct subbimodules; so the subbimodules form a chain, with one-dimensional successive quotients.
    • For f ≠ 0, R_xfR_y = R_xf or fR_y.
